name: Minazuki Hotaru
source:
"I see you aren't any color, yet."

A girl who gets along well with everyone and has a very expressive face. She speaks and acts like an uninhibited and free spirit, but she's intelligent and often helps [url=/c45359]Makoto[/url] by giving him advice. For some reason, Kotodama doesn't work on her.


Special skills: Telling bawdy stories
Hobbies: Photography (likes collecting memories)
Likes: Fireworks, shopping, the beach
Dislikes: Medicine, smartphones, noise

[Based on translation from the [url=http://www.purplesoftware.jp/products/amatsutsumi/#prettyPhoto]Developer's Site[/url]]
